title: The AI Productivity Gap
summary: This article discusses the growing productivity disparity between individuals and organizations that effectively leverage AI tools versus those that don't. Author Bjorn Roche explores how AI adoption is creating a new productivity gap in the workplace, with significant implications for management and competitive advantage.
problem_solved: Addresses why some workers and companies achieve dramatically different productivity gains from AI, creating inequality in the modern workplace.
why_valuable: Helps managers and organizations understand the strategic importance of AI adoption and provides frameworks for maximizing AI productivity gains across teams.
